SERVICE AGREEMENT

This agreement is made between Acme Ltd and Beta Co.

1. Services. Beta Co shall provide the services described in Schedule A.

2. Payment. Acme Ltd shall pay KES 100,000 per month within 30 days of invoice.

3. Termination. Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 60 days written notice.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the other's information confidential.

5. Governing law. This agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya.
